profile.headline: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary: Seeking a responsible post in an organization where I can apply the knowledge gained through my 7+ years of experience as a Software Developer. I can learn and adapt to emerging technologies. Comfortable to work as a team and can handle responsibilities individually as well. I firmly believe in the principle of implementing my duties with dedication and determination. Looking for good career growth opportunities where my talent and knowledge could be best subjected and utilized for the benefit of the organization and myself.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Architected monolithic applications to different microservices migration process and created deployment processes.
• Architected a blue green deployment process to achieve zero downtime during production releases.
• Designed and implemented a process to collect trading data from vendors, process it and persist in the database.
• Helped with on-call responsibilities and mitigated operations overhead by handling customer tickets, fixing bugs and pipeline blockers.
• Led the process to upgrade the java spring boot application framework from version 2 to 3
• Created monitoring dashboards in splunk to monitor the overall health of the application.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Dynatrace · Jenkins · Splunk · Kubernetes · Docker · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked for Morgan Stanley

• Architected and implemented the optimized rule matching algorithm on raw client data.
• Invented the data reconciliation process to reconcile data from multiple sources.
• Implemented a feature to reverse the merge process in the event of faulty reconciliation.
• Slashed the application memory usage by removing obsolete threads out of the memory pool.
• Implemented an automation testing suite using Selenium.
positions.insights: Skills: Sybase Adaptive Server · Java · Spring Framework

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Optimized the response time by adding caching feature and multithreading at the controller layer.
• Led the backend team by helping them resolve blockers and conducting code reviews
• Designed the anomaly detection architecture for detecting anomalies in the networking data.
• Integrated partners like Cisco ISE, ServiceNow, etc. into the base application using Spring Boot, MongoDB and Retrofit.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Spring Framework · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Conducted meetings with the client to understand the business requirements of the project.
• Created UI modules and implemented the underlying business logic using dynamic Angular components.
• Architected a testing pipeline to catch bugs in preprod by running continuous Canary tests.
• Collaborated with the DevOps team to build pipeline infrastructure to support the build process.

educations.schoolName: Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College of Engineering
